title: AI Is Changing the Way Businesses Work
summary: Artificial intelligence is changing the way businesses operate. Companies are using AI to improve productivity and make faster decisions. Experts also emphasize the importance of responsible use. The technology is expected to continue influencing workplaces around the world.
